name: Batch Service Interface
description: Provides a batch helper service and abstract class to support it.
project_description: Provides an abstract class, an interface, and a design pattern that make it easier to write Drupal Batch API processing as dependency-injected services. A developer extends AbstractBatchService (or implements BatchServiceInterface) to define a batch as a service that has clean access to translation, logging, and any other container services, instead of writing procedural batch operation arrays with global function callbacks. It ships a hidden batch_example submodule demonstrating the pattern.
